title: NeuroCodec: EEG-Guided Latent-Domain Generative Model for High-Fidelity Target Speaker Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2610.29815v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Driven by recent advancements in hearing assistive devices, target speaker extraction (TSE) in multi-talker environments has drawn significant attention. To address this, hearing technologies identify attention using neural signals recorded via electroencephalography (EEG) to guide TSE, enabling neuro-steered auditory attention decoding. However, most existing techniques rely on time-frequency masking, which suffers from low fidelity in spectro-temporally overlapping regions and is often restricted to narrowband audio. In contrast, we introduce NeuroCodec, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first generative EEG-guided TSE framework operating in the latent space of a neural audio codec. Specifically, NeuroCodec models spatial EEG dependencies via graph convolutions and fuses cross-modal EEG and speech representations through attention mechanisms and Mamba-based temporal modeling. translated_title: NeuroCodec：面向高保真目标说话人提取的EEG引导潜在域生成模型
translated_abstract: 在听力辅助设备近期发展的推动下，多说话人环境中的目标说话人提取（TSE）受到了广泛关注。为解决这一问题，听觉技术利用通过脑电图（EEG）记录的神经信号来识别注意力，以引导目标说话人提取，从而实现神经引导的听觉注意力解码。然而，大多数现有技术依赖于时频掩蔽方法，该方法在时频重叠区域的保真度较低，且通常仅限于窄带音频。相比之下，我们提出了NeuroCodec，据我们所知，这是首个在神经音频编解码器潜在空间中运行的生成式EEG引导目标说话人提取框架。具体而言，NeuroCodec通过图卷积建模EEG的空间依赖关系，并通过注意力机制和基于Mamba的时序建模来融合跨模态的EEG与语音表征。我们进一步引入了一个六阶段训练课程……
tldr: 提出NeuroCodec，首个在神经音频编解码器潜在空间中运行的生成式EEG引导目标说话人提取框架，通过图卷积建模EEG空间依赖并结合注意力机制与Mamba时序建模进行跨模态融合，突破了传统时频掩蔽方法保真度低和仅限窄带音频的局限。
en_tdlr: NeuroCodec is proposed as the first generative EEG-guided target speaker extraction framework operating in the latent space of a neural audio codec, which models EEG spatial dependencies via graph convolutions and fuses cross-modal representations through attention mechanisms and Mamba-based temporal modeling, overcoming the low fidelity and narrowband limitations of conventional time-frequency masking approaches.
